description: Extract evidence explicitly present in an officer's uploaded tax case document. Do not decide approval, access rights, compliance, or guilt.

DocumentType.description: Document type explicitly stated in the document; leave absent when not stated.

DocumentReference.description: Invoice, return, receipt, or other reference number printed on the document.

DocumentDate.description: Issue date explicitly stated on the document.

TaxPeriod.description: Tax period explicitly printed on this document, without inference from other dates.

Currency.description: Currency code or symbol explicitly stated beside the total.

StatedTotal.description: Final document total as printed, without recalculation.

LineItems.description: Rows explicitly present in the document's item table; do not infer missing rows or values.
